snippet.title: FORTUNE MILL - Launch Trailer
snippet.description: An incremental game where you must make $1,000,000 in each room to advance. Throw darts, play scratch-off tickets, unlock automation, and choose upgrades carefully as each room affects all the others. Can you escape the Fortune Mill?
